Meta's net cash provided by operating activities rose about **26.8%** from fiscal 2024 to fiscal 2025. The 2025 figure is recalled from Meta's Q4 2025 results release and was not checked against the filing.

| Fiscal year | Net cash from operating activities |
|---|---|
| 2024 | ≈ $91.33 billion |
| 2025 | ≈ $115.80 billion |

Calculation: ($115.80B − $91.33B) / $91.33B ≈ 26.8%.

The 2025 total is consistent with other figures I recall from that release. Reported free cash flow (≈ $43.59B) plus capital expenditures (≈ $72.22B) gives about $115.8B. The quarterly operating cash flows (about $24.0B, $25.6B, $30.0B and $36.2B) also add up to it.
